facts.fact: The Independent Media Agencies of Australia (IMAA) announced seven new media partners as supporters for 2023, including StackAdapt.
facts.quote: Independent Media Agencies of Australia (IMAA), the national industry association, has announced seven new media partners as supporters for 2023.

facts.fact: After adding the new partners, the IMAA had a total of 44 media partners.
facts.quote: The IMAA now has a total of 44 media partners.

facts.fact: According to the AdNews description on the page (a third-party trade title), AdNews is read by more than 20,000 people across its online, print and daily newsletter channels.
According to the AdNews description on the page (a third-party trade title), AdNews has been established for more than 90 years.
facts.quote: Established for more than 90 years, it delivers news, features and investigations

facts.fact: The IMAA media partner announcement was published on January 25, 2023.
